activitywiki-desc: Description of the ActivityWiki extension, shown on Special:Version. Should be a short sentence describing what the extension does.
activitywiki-default-create-summary: Fallback content string used in an ActivityPub activity when a page was created with no edit summary. This text is federated publicly to Fediverse followers — keep it neutral and brief. Do not translate markup or wiki syntax.
activitywiki: {{doc-special|ActivityWiki}} Also used, lowercased, as both the page's title and its entry in Special:SpecialPages, per MediaWiki's default SpecialPage::getDescription() behaviour.
activitywiki-section-federation: Section heading on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] for the federation enabled/disabled row.
activitywiki-federation-disabled:
Shown on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] when $wgActivityWikiEnabled is false. Parameters:
* $1 - not used; the literal config variable name "$wgActivityWikiEnabled" appears in the English source as plain text, not as a message parameter, since it is a technical identifier that should not be translated.
activitywiki-section-webfinger: Section heading on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] for the live WebFinger reachability check.
activitywiki-webfinger-state-ok: Shown on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] when the live probe of this wiki's own public WebFinger URL succeeded and matched this wiki's expected actor.
activitywiki-webfinger-state-misconfigur: Shown on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] when the WebFinger probe got an HTTP response, but it was not a valid WebFinger document for this wiki's actor (wrong rewrite target, or wrong actor returned).
activitywiki-webfinger-state-unreachable: Shown on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] when the WebFinger probe could not get any usable HTTP response at all (connection refused, DNS failure, timeout, or a non-2xx/error status).
activitywiki-webfinger-probed-url: Table row label on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] for the public WebFinger URL that was probed.
activitywiki-webfinger-http-status: Table row label on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] for the HTTP status code returned by the WebFinger probe.
activitywiki-webfinger-http-status-none: Shown on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] in place of an HTTP status code when the probe received no response at all (as opposed to receiving an error status such as 404).
activitywiki-webfinger-detail: Table row label on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] for the human-readable explanation of the WebFinger check's result.
activitywiki-webfinger-setup-hint: Shown on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] only when the WebFinger check did not succeed, pointing the operator at the extension's own README for the manual setup steps. "README" and "WebFinger routing" refer to literal section/file names in the extension's documentation and should not be translated or need not match translated section headings elsewhere.
activitywiki-section-followers: Section heading on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] for the follower count.
activitywiki-follower-count:
Shown on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] with the number of remote Fediverse actors currently following this wiki. Parameters:
* $1 - the follower count, a non-negative integer. Supports {{PLURAL:$1|...}}.
activitywiki-section-jobqueue: Section heading on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] for the pending-job-queue table.
activitywiki-jobqueue-col-type: Column header in the job queue table on [[Special:ActivityWiki]]. The cells beneath it are internal MediaWiki job class names (e.g. "MediawikiActivityPubDelivery") and are never translated themselves.
activitywiki-jobqueue-col-ready: Column header in the job queue table on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] — jobs in the queue that are ready to run but not yet claimed by a job runner.
activitywiki-jobqueue-col-delayed: Column header in the job queue table on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] — jobs scheduled to retry later after a failed delivery attempt.
activitywiki-jobqueue-col-pending: Column header in the job queue table on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] — the sum of the "ready" and "delayed" columns.
activitywiki-section-key: Section heading on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] for the signing key fingerprint.
activitywiki-key-fingerprint-label: Table row label on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] for the wiki's RSA public key fingerprint.
activitywiki-key-missing: Shown on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] in place of the key fingerprint when no RSA key pair has been generated yet. "update.php" and "maintenance/GenerateKeys.php" are literal command/file names and should not be translated.
activitywiki-section-recent-activity: Section heading on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] for the recent federated activity log.
activitywiki-recent-activity-empty: Shown on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] in place of the recent-activity table when no activity has ever been federated from this wiki.
activitywiki-recent-activity-col-type: Column header in the recent-activity table on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] — the ActivityPub activity type (e.g. "Create", "Update", "Delete"), shown as stored and not translated.
activitywiki-recent-activity-col-object: Column header in the recent-activity table on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] — the ActivityPub object type the activity acted on (e.g. "Article"), shown as stored and not translated.
activitywiki-recent-activity-col-page: Column header in the recent-activity table on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] — the wiki page title the activity was about.
activitywiki-recent-activity-col-user: Column header in the recent-activity table on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] — the wiki user whose edit triggered the activity.
activitywiki-recent-activity-col-time: Column header in the recent-activity table on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] — when the activity was created, shown in the viewing user's own time zone and date format preference.
activitywiki-recent-activity-col-deliver: Column header in the recent-activity table on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] — whether the activity has been delivered to followers' inboxes yet.
activitywiki-yes: Generic "yes" used in the recent-activity table on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] (the "Delivered" column). {{Identical|Yes}}
activitywiki-no: Generic "no" used in the recent-activity table on [[Special:ActivityWiki]] (the "Delivered" column). {{Identical|No}}
